metadata.description: Real Agent's plugins for estate agents: the Real Agent knowledge base each firm keeps in its own Supabase project, its organisational knowledge base (OKB), and the agents that work in it.

plugins.name: real-agent
plugins.description: The database operator, every member of staff's agent for their firm's Real Agent knowledge base, the organisational knowledge base (OKB), with the skills every firm gets: adding staff, approving a model, getting started, updating plugins and support.

plugins.name: okb
plugins.description: Lets each person work in their firm's Real Agent knowledge base, its organisational knowledge base (OKB), in the firm's own Supabase project, within their own permissions: records, files and their search, the glossary and data dictionary, boards, graphs and printed PDFs.

plugins.name: business-analyst
plugins.description: The business analyst, the agent of a firm's owner and administrators. It sets up Real Agent for the firm: its Real Agent knowledge base, the organisational knowledge base (OKB), in its own Supabase project. Then it keeps the firm's scopes, staff and grants, and interviews its people about their routines, saving each confirmed routine as a model of how the work is done today.
